task_text: Set the thermal mixer by pressing the buttons of its panel: time 30 s, temperature 33 °C, mixing speed 600 rpm. The panel's display shows the current settings (time, set / actual temperature, speed), and each setting has an up and a down button. The episode is judged in the state in which it ends: success iff the panel is then set to exactly these three values. The score reported as `progress` is 0.5 x temperature + 0.3 x time + 0.2 x speed, each term the fraction of the way from the initial to the target value.

inventory: thermal mixer (Eppendorf ThermoMixer C model) with a display and a button panel
